summary: Canada, Russia, Australia and the US come fast and the island nations follow; Norway at #2 is the surprise, and big coasts like Brazil (#16), India and Chile are the traps.
reasons: All ten are household names. A casual found 7 in 12 guesses, losing lives on Brazil, India, Chile, the UK and Mexico (#12 to #19, each with its figure): near misses that teach the trick, islands and fjords beat size. A fan found all 10.

CIA World Factbook figures, named in the prompt, match the Factbook. Sovereign states only: Greenland is free, territories cost a life marked "not a sovereign state", landlocked countries show 0 km. No tie at #10/#11.
Shares 7 of its 10 answers with island-countries (Today's list on Nov 12): run it weeks apart. Strong Blitz: 34 of 36 casual names scored.
fixes: Antarctica costs a life showing 17,968 km (a top-10 figure, would be #9), while Greenland, also not a sovereign country, is free: add Antarctica to `skip` like Greenland.
Denmark's miss shows 7,314 km with no word that Greenland is counted apart, so players who reach Denmark through Greenland will think it wrong: label it "7,314 km (without Greenland)".
